intro: A fresh set of mini-challenges for this week. Pick one, try it, and tell someone how you solved it.

activities.title: Pattern Detective
activities.prompt: Open What Comes Next? Find the repeating pattern, choose the missing item, and explain the clue you noticed.

activities.title: Animal Memory Mission
activities.prompt: Flip two cards at a time. Can you find all the matching animal pairs using as few flips as you can?

activities.title: Design a Creature
activities.prompt: Open Animal Colour Studio. Choose three colours and make a creature with a colour pattern of your own.

activities.title: Odd-One-Out Challenge
activities.prompt: Find the item that does not belong. Then say one reason why the other three belong together.

activities.title: Who Am I?
activities.prompt: Play Who Am I? Look carefully at the animal silhouette and select the matching animal.

activities.title: Make a Silly Character
activities.prompt: Use Make Brainrot Names to invent a character. Give it one helpful superpower and describe it in one sentence.
